purpose: Test whether a fresh reader can reconstruct what happened, what Lolla inferred, what deterministic pressure did or did not reach reconsideration, what failed, and what the receipt cannot prove.
integrity_limit: This contract was not frozen before T1 execution. It can test receipt transfer and comprehension, but it cannot repair T1's posthoc comparative-review limitation or establish a clean causal usefulness claim.

allowed: this reader instruction and response contract

sample.reason_for_selection: operationally complete case later diagnosed as a false stand-down
operationally complete case later diagnosed as a correct stand-down
role extraction succeeded at the provider boundary but failed the local join contract
execution stopped at the first provider call because available credit could not cover the frozen request

reader_instruction: Read the receipt as the only evidence. Distinguish quoted or recorded facts from Lolla's probabilistic interpretations and from your own inference.
Reconstruct the user's decision or problem, the important changes across the conversation, the final position, and any material unresolved matter.
Explain what Lolla extracted, which mechanisms it treated as unresolved or covered, and why the system routed to pressure, park, or stand-down.
Explain what deterministic candidate work occurred and whether any graph-only candidate actually reached a fresh reasoner.
Describe the public outputs or explain why they do not exist.
Name any execution failure, missing artifact, or ambiguity that limits reconstruction.
Separate what the receipt proves about custody and execution from what it does not prove about reasoning quality, correctness, usefulness, or trustworthiness.
Do not issue a score, badge, winner, confidence percentage, or recommendation about the underlying case.

response_contract.evidence_rule: Each material statement must identify whether its basis is source conversation, probabilistic interpretation, deterministic ledger, provider custody, public output, or reader inference.

execution_policy.reason: The receipt structure can be frozen and validated locally. A model call remains paused pending the explicit cost/model decision, and human review requires founder participation.
